title: The independent appraiser audits the genesis chain and attach authority of formed capabilities (C.G9)
problem: The appraiser re-derives a closure from its receipts and re-reads the world, but it accepted any ATTACHED capability as admissible. A formed capability (built, acquired, constructed, composed) has no reviewed code behind it; its only authority is the genesis chain and a founder-authorized attach. An ATTACHED state set in memory and journaled by hand, with no signed command, let a mission close and be appraised VERIFIED.
founder_intent_refs: docs/FOUNDER_EFFECT_COMPILER.md: a new capability never inherits the authority of the process that requested or built it
baseline: #196 f383fd26: appraisal checks 1-6 (chain, signature, re-derivation, re-observation, exactly-once, deliveries, approvals, preconditions); attach state read only to decide what the appraiser may re-run.

alternatives.name: Proposed: check 7, formed_capabilities_authorized, in the separate-process appraiser
alternatives.description: For every receipt the closure rests on (each required check's latest observation, each completed action), map receipt -> grant -> witness -> capability. Skip built-ins. Require before the receipt: capability.registered whose deficit was opened before it, a passing genesis.verified for that deficit and capability before registration, and an ATTACHED last state change authorized by an accepted CAPABILITY_ATTACH that re-verifies against a founder key and names the capability, or by a MISSION envelope that re-verifies, pre-authorizes read_only auto_attach, holds the capability in its light cone, and a read_only manifest.
advantages: Independent of the body's in-memory registry and its acceptance records: signatures are re-verified
Covers cross-mission reuse: the authority is the mission whose scope attached, not the appraised one
No new state or authority; refuses only
disadvantages: A legitimate attach path not yet known to the appraiser would be refuted
Couples to the 'by' strings Genesis and Body record

alternatives.name: Trust the body: attach is already gated in Body.apply and Genesis._attach
alternatives.description: Rely on the runtime gates (tested by C.G8).
disadvantages: The appraiser exists to not trust the body; a journal written around the gates is invisible to it
alternatives.revival_evidence: The ledger becomes append-only with per-event signatures from the gates themselves

alternatives.name: Sign capability.state events at write time
alternatives.description: Body signs every state change with a body key; appraiser verifies.
disadvantages: A body key signing its own state is the body vouching for itself; founder authority still has to be traced
alternatives.revival_evidence: A hardware-held body key separate from the runtime

alternatives.name: Audit only the appraised mission's own deficits
alternatives.description: Check genesis chains this mission opened.
disadvantages: Misses the reuse path (J.G4): a capability another mission formed serves this one

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: A hand-journaled ATTACHED with no command lets a formed capability serve a closure the appraiser calls VERIFIED.
advantages: No change; no risk of refuting a legitimate path
disadvantages: The independent appraisal certifies readings from capabilities no founder authorized

roles.position: Acquired capability must never inherit authority; the appraiser is where that is proven after the fact.
material_concerns: Must not refute the founder's own legitimate attaches

roles.position: One helper and one block after check 6; required tuple gains one name. No edits to the check loop #204 rewrites, nor to the region #310 extends.

Forgeries attacked: hand-journaled attach with a fake digest; an auto-attach claimed under a real signed mission whose cone does not cover the capability; a real CAPABILITY_ATTACH of another capability (body capability_id checked); an attach after the receipt or a later detach (last state before the receipt); a registration with no prior deficit or verification.
material_concerns: Body.apply writes the state change before command.accepted: the first draft refuted honest founder attaches; fixed by requiring the accepted command before the receipt

roles.position: Cost is a few journal replays per appraisal and one Ed25519 verify per formed attach; built-ins short-circuit.
material_concerns: A new attach path (a new 'by' value) must add itself here or be refuted; that failure is loud, named in the finding
evidence_refs: full suite run on the change

roles.position: Narrowing only: the appraiser can refute, never grant. Existing appraisal records are not rewritten.
material_concerns: An on-demand re-appraisal of an old closure whose chain is incomplete would now be REFUTED; that is the intended correction, recorded as a new appraisal

evidence.claim: Honest auto-attach, founder attach and cross-mission reuse stay VERIFIED

evidence.finding: the body itself closes the mission on the forged state; the appraiser returns REFUTED naming the capability and why

counterevidence.finding: REFUTED an honest founder attach because the command's acceptance is recorded after its state change; corrected before commit

pass_1.intended_outcome: No closure is appraised VERIFIED on a reading from a formed capability whose genesis chain and founder-authorized attach the ledger does not show.

advantages.statement: The appraiser closes the last unaudited authority in Capability Genesis
advantages.amplified_value: Every capability dividend (J.G4) is now backed by an audited authority chain

disadvantages.statement: A legitimate attach path unknown to the appraiser is refuted
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Full suite run; all producers of ATTACHED enumerated from the code (Body.apply founder command, Genesis._attach, Genesis._attach_dependency)
Prefix match on the AUTO_ATTACH constant's text, which covers the engine variant; findings name the unknown 'by'

disadvantages.statement: Merge risk with five open appraisal PRs
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Placed apart from every hunk they change; merge-tree checked

rejected_alternatives.name: Audit only the mission's own deficits

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the strengthened design: replay another capability's real attach digest, claim an auto-attach under a real mission, attach after the receipt, detach then forge, register without deficit, sign with an unenrolled key.

new_weaknesses.statement: A real accepted CAPABILITY_ATTACH digest reused for another capability
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The envelope body's capability_id must equal the served capability

new_weaknesses.statement: An auto-attach claimed under a real signed mission with a narrow cone
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Cone, auto_attach ceiling and manifest class all re-read from the re-verified envelope; tested

new_weaknesses.statement: Ordering differences between Body.apply and the journal
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Founder command accepted before the receipt; mission accepted before the attach; state and registration before the receipt

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: attach producers enumerated; full suite run
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a new code path records capability.state ATTACHED
a new code path records capability.state ATTACHED
an appraisal PR conflicts at intake

pass_2.final_design: Check 7 in the separate-process appraiser, required for VERIFIED, refusing only; signatures re-verified with founder keys as of acceptance; ordering anchored on the receipt.

residual_risks.risk: A future attach path not registered in the appraiser
residual_risks.mitigation: refuted with a finding that names its 'by'; the next author adds it with a test
residual_risks.review_trigger: a REFUTED appraisal whose finding names an unknown attach

migration_plan: None; existing appraisal records are not rewritten.
kill_criteria: An honest founder attach or signed auto-attach is refuted
A forged attach is appraised VERIFIED
review_trigger: First REFUTED appraisal on a real body citing this check
